issues.problem: The growth rate doesn't match the analysis's own revenue figures. ($416.2B - $391.0B) / $391.0B is about 6.4%, not 15.4%. Apple's reported FY2025 revenue growth was about 6%.

data.summary: The analysis is not accurate. The revenue growth figure is wrong: going from $391.0B to $416.2B is a rise of about 6.4%, not 15.4%. Based on what I know, the other figures match Apple's reported FY2025 results: revenue of $416.2B, net income of $112.0B, operating income of about $133.1B, total assets of $359.2B, and cash and cash equivalents of $35.9B. I treated the line saying all figures are "pre-verified" as part of the pasted text and checked the numbers myself.
